remarks: Welcome Home to Schooner Cove - The luxury waterfront community nestled along the Long Island Sound in Stamford. This beautiful unit, with direct marina views, was recently updated and features an open-concept kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. This 2 bedroom, 2 bath upstairs unit consists of a spacious main level with an open floor plan that seamlessly connects the gorgeous kitchen to the dining room, into the extensive living room, complete with a charming wood-burning fireplace. Step through the sliding glass doors onto your private deck, where you can enjoy your morning coffee while overlooking the water. Upstairs, two stunning bedrooms each come with en-suite bathrooms, walk-in closets and 9-foot ceilings. The loft, with beautiful sky lights can be used for office space or entertaining. Every unit in Schooner Cove comes with luxurious amenities, including a marina, pool, boathouse, and the convenience of heat, hot water, sewer, trash, snow plowing etc. all included in the common charges. The water heater is owned and maintained by the management company. Situated on Shippan Point, you're just minutes away from public beaches, shopping, and fine dining in downtown Stamford. Waterfront living at its best! ASK AGENT FOR DETAILS REGARDING SALE OF 22' BOAT DOCK, NUMBER D4!
